item.title: 'I've got some more living to do': The legacy of Richmond's Duchess of the Blues
item.description: As jazz scales fill Révéler Experiences in Carytown, Lady E, adorned in sparkly jewelry and back-lit by colorful string lights, stands the test of time.

item.title: From pain to pages: Grieving aunt and wife pens memoir to spread hope
item.description: Three years after losing her nephew in a murder that's never been solved, one woman is now sharing how she has coped with her grief in a memoir, in hopes she can help others.

item.title: 2026 Short List announced for Newlin Music Prize
item.description: The 2026 Short List has been announced for the Newlin Music Prize, with an opportunity for fans to vote for their favorite local albums as well.

item.title: Virginia lawmakers want to put a stop to predatory solar companies
item.description: More solar panels are popping up on top of homes as the solar industry continues to boom across the Commonwealth. Now, lawmakers want to put a stop to predatory solar companies trying to take advantage of Virginians.

item.title: 'The Commonwealth has truly lost a great one': Virginia House of Delegates honors actor Robert Duvall
item.description: The Virginia House of Delegates honored actor and director Robert Duvall on Monday, a day after his death, recognizing his long-standing career and philanthropy.

item.title: 'It's bigger than the dollar': Several Black-owned businesses holding pay-what-you-can week
item.description: For the second year in a row, several local and Black-owned businesses are holding 'Unity Pay-What-You-Can Week'.

item.title: 55-year-old man missing out of Greene County since January
item.description: The Greene County Sheriff's Office is asking for the public's help to find a 55-year-old man that has been missing since January.

item.title: Virginia to enforce law limiting minors' social media use to one hour daily
item.description: Attorney General Jay Jones announced Monday that his office will require social media platforms to limit minors' usage to only one hour a day unless a parent or guardian chooses to increase the limit.

item.title: Virginia House pass paid sick leave, prescription drug affordability bills
item.description: Virginia House Democrats have passed bills to create a prescription drug affordability board and require employers to provide paid sick time off.

item.title: 18-year-old identified as man killed in Henrico shooting
item.description: An 18-year-old man has been identified as the man killed in a shooting in Henrico County on Sunday night.
